description: This source file defines a SwiftUI View called CronJobEditor, which provides a user interface for creating and editing Cron jobs related to the OpenClaw project. It includes numerous properties, state variables, and UI components to support configuration of schedule, payload, session targeting, and other Cron job parameters.

classes.name: CronJobEditor
classes.description: A SwiftUI View facilitating the creation and editing of scheduled Cron jobs with various configurable options such as schedule type, payload, and session parameters.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the SwiftUI layout for the CronJobEditor view, including form elements for job configuration and action buttons.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Initializes the view's state variables based on the provided CronJob instance.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates input, constructs a CronJob object, and invokes the onSave callback.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Helper function to create consistently styled labels for form grid rows.
